scope.exhaustiveBreakpoints: Every published source knot, all profile endpoints, exact endpoints and midpoints of every adjacent open interval; endpoint neighbours ±1e-9 additionally probed.

scope.conditionalContext: Term birth and G1/Th1 are explicitly hypothetical supplied facts. No Tanner stage, cycle phase, pregnancy, menopause, assay or specimen is inferred from age.

probeMethod.commonJsVsBrowserVmParity: Every ordinary evaluate result compared with actual browser-VM export; no mismatches.
probeMethod.noSingleValueForInterval: Segments summarize evaluated status/category, merging contiguous equal-status intervals after all boundary and interior probes. probeMethod.sourceNodeRounding: Source ages retain their actual floating-point endpoints; no rounding to month/year changes routing.
